description: Defines the SystemInfo class and related nested classes implementing system subsystem interfaces such as Identifier, Provisioning, Internet, Security, Location, and Time within the Thunder::PluginHost namespace. It manages system information, notifications, and subsystem state updates.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Main class managing system subsystem information and notifications within the Thunder plugin framework.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Id
classes.description: Represents a system identifier with methods to set and retrieve device-specific identification info.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Provisioning
classes.description: Iterator class for provisioning information, managing storage labels and data.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Internet
classes.description: Represents internet connectivity info, including IP address and network type.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Security
classes.description: Represents security info, primarily the callsign.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Location
classes.description: Holds geographic location data such as timezone, country, region, city, latitude, and longitude.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Set
methods.description: Sets subsystem information of a specific type and triggers notifications.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Unset
methods.description: Removes subsystem information of a specific type and triggers notifications.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Get
methods.description: Retrieves current subsystem information of a specific type.

methods.name: SystemInfo::IsActive
methods.description: Checks if a subsystem type is active.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Value
methods.description: Returns the current subsystem flags as a bitmask.

methods.name: SystemInfo::BuildTreeHash
methods.description: Builds a hash representing the system info tree.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Version
methods.description: Returns the version string of the system info.
